blocks.text: PRODUCT DESCRIPTION：GAOFAN HOUR Gold Watches for Women This square case women's gold watch dial design is delicate and simple, with a delicate square outline to highlight the unique personality, simplicity reveals the extraordinary fashion taste,adjustable strap skin-friendly and comfortable to fit the wrist.Whether with a professional suit to show the workplace women's competence,or with an evening dress to highlight the elegance of temperament can inadvertently reveal the noble temperament.Package included：1* GAOFAN HOUR Gold Watch1* Watch Box1* strap adjuster1* User Manual

items.label: ELEGANT AND FASHIONABLE DESIGN
items.value: This square case women's gold watch dial design is delicate and simple, with a delicate square outline to highlight the unique personality, simplicity reveals the extraordinary fashion taste,adjustable strap skin-friendly and comfortable to fit the wrist.Whether with a professional suit to show the workplace women's competence,or with an evening dress to highlight the elegance of temperament can inadvertently reveal the noble temperament.

items.label: GOLD COLOURED STAINLESS STEEL BRACELET
items.value: The band size of this watch can be resized,please use the included tool and watch the video to adjust it.The strap is crafted from high quality stainless steel with luxurious gold plating,creating a layered and three-dimensional look that expresses your personality and taste.

items.label: DURABLE AND RELIABLE
items.value: The gold watch utilizes a high quality movement and battery to ensure accurate timekeeping.The dial is decorated with white Roman dials in a classic and elegant design with a strong vintage flavor.The high-strength coated glass crystal is resistant to scratches,shocks and abrasions.Water resistant to 3 ATM ( 99feet),it can withstand daily activities such as hand washing,splashing and sweating.

items.label: PERFECT GIFT FOR HER
items.value: This watches for women not only shows the exquisite charm of the watch,but also illustrates the wearer's relentless pursuit of quality and fashion.Ideal gift for weddings, anniversaries,birthdays,parties,Valentine's Day,Mother's Day,Christmas and other special holidays.

items.label: BUY WITH CONFIDENCE
items.value: If you are not satisfied with any of our watch products,feel free to contact us,we will be wholeheartedly for you to solve!

items.label: Included Components
items.value: Gaofan Hour Gold Watch, Strap Adjuster Tool, User Manual, Watch Box
